scope: batch6 minimum consumer-owned Popover content using public composition; not full batch/issue maturity
status: bounded public API, real consumer, GPU, tool-native and token evidence accepted
root_cause: Content child painting was private/automatic, so existing PopoverView callback could not compose the same mounted owned subtree. Focus mount identity existed only in Dialog; View lacked a layout-only entry.
shared_fix: Component.paints_children default false; public existing Content.paint/paint_overlays retain the same host/layout/lifecycle/input/semantics
capture_focus/restore_focus reuse current mount identity; Dialog shares this existing logic
PopoverView.arrange shares production geometry and never revives closed dismiss focus
retained owned text still requires a real text backend
consumer_corrections: Use actual ancestor popup clip rather than content rect; exact rejected native source/screenshot and Scene red/green kept
Dismiss owns Space down/up; normal reconciliation Cancel only cancels gesture, never acts as window deactivation
Explicit platform deactivation closes/clears and revokes return intent, including inactive input fence
Nonmodal close preserves newer outside focus; replacement/remount cannot inherit stale return focus
applicable: Consumer-defined Components that must paint their owned Content inside existing callbacks; all temporary presentations may use shared mount-validated focus intent. Popover is first minimum consumer, not upper bound.
exceptions: Default automatic paint unchanged. No builtin PopoverContent, broad migration, Window Toolbar registration, another host/state machine, or new tokens. Source matrix keeps native/whole-component maturity unverified.

real_consumer.composition: same ContentHost with actual TextField/Switch plus consumer-defined Caption

gpu.reference: explicit wrong focus clip, not pre-fix GPU binary; exact old native images/source retained

native.method: actual AppKit key/menu/AX and actual window lifecycle, no physical pinyin or VoiceOver claim

gold7: Scoped menu/popup focus, normal versus Reduced Motion close, event isolation, edit/selection retention and fresh intent checked in actual GPU/native images and events; final page/whole-family acceptance remains separate.

tokens.meaning: owned-tree lookups include Caption/TextField/Switch; not attributed to primitive shell

source: source-manifest.json; new token test/script separately pinned in token-probes/popover-content.json
not_done: remaining batch6 chosen consumer integration and same-final-candidate combined acceptance
